children: NMP Acquisition entered into Amendment No. 1 to its Business Combination Agreement with GTS to extend the deadline for delivering audited financials to October 9, 2026. NMP may further extend the delivery date at its sole discretion by written notice. The amendment clarifies that the Audit Delivery Date governs filing timing, with the Registration Statement due within five business days thereafter, and deems prior delays not to be a breach. All other terms of the Business Combination Agreement remain unchanged.
: Amendment No. 1 to Business Combination Agreement
: Extend audit delivery deadline and clarify registration filing timing
